evidence.text: The present retrospective study evaluated the supplementary value of gross tumor volume of the primary nasopharyngeal tumor (GTVnx) for overall survival (OS) risk stratification in patients with T3-4 nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC).
A total of 118 patients with T3-4 NPC who received definitive intensity-modulated radiotherapy at Guilin People's Hospital (Guilin, China) between March 2020 and June 2025 were included.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】Clinical and extended models were compared using the concordance index (C-index), Akaike information criterion (AIC) and time-dependent area under the curve (AUC), and sensitivity analyses were performed to assess robustness.

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】The 36-month time-dependent ROC analysis identified 78 cm3 as the exploratory cut-off for GTVnx, with an AUC of 0.709.

evidence.text: Clinical and extended models were compared using the concordance index (C-index), Akaike information criterion (AIC) and time-dependent area under the curve (AUC), and sensitivity analyses were performed to assess robustness.
The 36-month time-dependent ROC analysis identified 78 cm3 as the exploratory cut-off for GTVnx, with an AUC of 0.709.
